verdict.rationale: Recurly's own docs only glancingly touch this story: subscription changes include "trial handling" and discounts, and coupons appear as an exportable data type. That suggests trials and coupons exist, but nothing shows how they are configured or run. Missing for 10: documented free-trial setup, coupon and promotion-code creation and redemption, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, trial-end notifications meeting card-network rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules

citations.quote: with control over timing, proration behavior, credits, charges, discounts, and trial handling
from customer records and subscriptions to invoices, coupons, transactions, and revenue recognition
